result.instructions: Tools for ManyChat, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tags does our ManyChat page have, and how many subscribers carry the 'vip' tag?"; "Find the subscriber named Ana García and show her custom field values."; "Add the 'webinar-2026' tag to subscriber 501.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes ManyChat data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run manychat_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run manychat_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run manychat_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. manychat_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: manychat_get_page_info
tools.title: Get page info
tools.description: Get the connected ManyChat page (the Facebook or Instagram page the key belongs to): id, name and basic settings. A good first call to confirm the connection. GET /fb/page/getInfo.

tools.name: manychat_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List all tags on the page with their ids. Use the ids with the add and remove tag tools. GET /fb/page/getTags.

tools.name: manychat_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: List the subscriber custom fields on the page with their ids and types. GET /fb/page/getCustomFields.

tools.name: manychat_list_flows
tools.title: List flows
tools.description: List the automations (flows) and their folders. Use a flow's ns with manychat_send_flow. GET /fb/page/getFlows.

tools.name: manychat_list_bot_fields
tools.title: List bot fields
tools.description: List the page-level bot fields (values shared by all subscribers) with their ids. GET /fb/page/getBotFields.

tools.name: manychat_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber (contact) by id: name, channel, tags, custom field values and subscription status. GET /fb/subscriber/getInfo.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber (contact) id, from a find or list tool.

tools.name: manychat_get_subscriber_by_user_ref
tools.title: Get a subscriber by user ref
tools.description: Get one subscriber by its user ref (the channel user id, for example a Messenger user ref). GET /fb/subscriber/getInfoByUserRef.

user_ref.description: The channel user ref of the subscriber.

annotations.title: Get a subscriber by user ref

tools.name: manychat_find_subscribers_by_name
tools.title: Find subscribers by name
tools.description: Find up to 100 subscribers whose name matches. Use the ids with the other subscriber tools. GET /fb/subscriber/findByName.

name.description: The name to search for (full name, as stored in ManyChat).

tools.name: manychat_find_subscribers_by_custom_field
tools.title: Find subscribers by custom field
tools.description: Find up to 100 subscribers whose custom field equals a value. GET /fb/subscriber/findByCustomField.

field_id.description: The custom field id, from manychat_list_custom_fields.

field_value.description: The value to match, as a string.

tools.name: manychat_find_subscriber_by_system_field
tools.title: Find a subscriber by email or phone
tools.description: Find one subscriber by its email or phone number (give at least one). GET /fb/subscriber/findBySystemField.

phone.description: The subscriber phone number, with country code.

annotations.title: Find a subscriber by email or phone

tools.name: manychat_create_tag
tools.title: Create a tag
tools.description: Create a new tag on the page. Fails if a tag with that name exists. POST /fb/page/createTag.

tools.name: manychat_add_tag_to_subscriber
tools.title: Add a tag to a subscriber
tools.description: Add a tag to one subscriber. Adding a tag twice has no extra effect. POST /fb/subscriber/addTag.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber (contact) id, from a find or list tool.

annotations.title: Add a tag to a subscriber

tools.name: manychat_remove_tag_from_subscriber
tools.title: Remove a tag from a subscriber
tools.description: Remove a tag from one subscriber. POST /fb/subscriber/removeTag.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber (contact) id, from a find or list tool.

annotations.title: Remove a tag from a subscriber

tools.name: manychat_set_custom_field
tools.title: Set a custom field
tools.description: Set one custom field value on one subscriber. POST /fb/subscriber/setCustomField.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber (contact) id, from a find or list tool.

field_id.description: The custom field id, from manychat_list_custom_fields.

field_value.description: The new value: a string, a whole number or a boolean, matching the field type.

tools.name: manychat_send_flow
tools.title: Start a flow for a subscriber
tools.description: Start one automation (flow) for one subscriber. The subscriber then receives the flow's real messages. Use manychat_list_flows for the flow ns. POST /fb/sending/sendFlow.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber (contact) id, from a find or list tool.

annotations.title: Start a flow for a subscriber

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with ManyChat
prompts.description: What you can do with ManyChat here, with example requests to try.
